s.n: Isle of Skye smoked salmon oatcakes
s.note: Oatcakes topped with lemon and dill crème fraîche, smoked salmon, capers and cracked pepper
s.how: Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon, a squeeze of juice, 1 tbsp chopped dill and pepper. Spread over 16 oatcakes, top each with a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, a few capers and a dill sprig. Finish with cracked pepper.

s.n: Janek's Christmas tree pigs in blankets
s.note: Chipolatas wrapped in streaky bacon, roasted with a honey and wholegrain mustard glaze and rosemary
s.how: Halve 6 rashers of streaky bacon lengthways and wrap one around each of 12 chipolatas. Roast at 200C for 15 minutes. Brush with 2 tbsp honey mixed with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and roast 10 minutes more until sticky. Spear with rosemary sprigs to serve.

m.note: Seared beef eye fillet in mustard, prosciutto and thyme mushroom duxelles, baked in golden puff pastry
m.how: Season an 800g centre-cut eye fillet and sear all over in oil, then brush with 2 tbsp Dijon. Blitz 500g mushrooms and 2 garlic cloves and cook in 25g butter with thyme until dry. Cool both. Lay 8 slices prosciutto on cling film, spread with the mushrooms, roll the beef up tight and chill 20 minutes. Wrap in 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg, score and bake at 210C for 35 minutes for medium rare. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

w.note: Rich dark chocolate baked custards, chilled and topped with crème fraîche and blackberries
w.how: Heat 300ml thickened cream and 100ml milk to steaming and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 40g caster sugar and a pinch of salt, whisk in the chocolate cream and strain into 4 ramekins. Bake in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes until set at the edges with a wobble. Cool, chill 3 hours and top with crème fraîche and blackberries.

d.note: Scotch whisky shaken with honey syrup and lemon over ice, with a dark drop of blackcurrant
d.how: Stir 60ml honey into 60ml hot water and cool. Shake 240ml Scotch whisky, the honey syrup and 80ml lemon juice hard with ice. Strain into 4 tumblers over fresh ice and let 1 tsp blackcurrant cordial sink into each.
